newsitem.title: CHINA: China Pacific Insurance profit over 600 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Pacific Insurance profit over 600 mln yuan.

text.p: The China Pacific Insurance Co (CPIC) reported a profit of more than 600 million yuan ($72 million) in 1996, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Wednesday.
It did not say whether the profits were pre-tax.
Premium income from its the domestic and international business reached 9.82 billion yuan in 1996 and 10 percent above the target for the year, it said.
Premium income included 5.957 billion yuan from property insurance and 3.862 billion yuan from life insurance, it said.
The newspaper said CPIC hoped premium income would hit 14 billion yuan in 1997, with profit reaching 700 million yuan, it said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
